haithabu.name: Haithabu (Hedeby)
haithabu.slogan: A Viking trading town on the Schlei, rebuilt plank by plank.
haithabu.line: A very large city at the very end of the world's ocean.
haithabu.by: Ibrahim ibn Yaqub, c. 965, on Hedeby

holtenaulocks.name: Holtenau Locks
holtenaulocks.slogan: Giant ships glide past the cafe tables at the canal's Baltic gate.
holtenaulocks.line: About 32,000 ships a year use the Kiel Canal, and it saves a 460 km detour around Denmark.

laboeehrenmal.name: Laboe Naval Memorial
laboeehrenmal.slogan: A brick sail above the fjord, with the whole Baltic below.
laboeehrenmal.line: Opened in 1936 as a memorial to German navy dead, it was rededicated in 1954 to sailors of all nations lost at sea.

westerhever.name: Westerheversand Lighthouse
westerhever.slogan: Red and white stripes on a lonely salt-marsh spit.
westerhever.line: Lit in 1908, it hosts weddings in its keeper's cottage and starred on the cover of an Otto film.

rathausturmkiel.name: Kiel Town Hall Tower
rathausturmkiel.slogan: Venice's bell tower, rebuilt taller for a navy town.
rathausturmkiel.line: At 106 m, Kiel's tower rises about 7 m above its model, the Campanile of St Mark's in Venice.
